report.title: Aapki report taiyaar hai
report.subtitle: Yahan aapki report ki seedhi-saadhi bhasha mein jaankari di gayi hai.
report.analysis_unavailable_desc: Yeh report nahi mil saki. Ho sakta hai yeh hata di gayi ho ya link galat ho.
report.analysis_failed_desc: CareAI aapki file nahi padh saka. File shayad kharab ho, password se protected ho, ya padhne layak na ho. Kripya ek saaf PDF upload karein.
report.analyzing: Aapki report padhi jaa rahi hai
report.analyzing_desc: CareAI aapki report ko step by step dekh raha hai. Isme usually 10–20 seconds lagte hain.
report.reading: Report kholi aur padhi jaa rahi hai
report.identifying: Kiye gaye tests ki pehchaan ho rahi hai
report.finding: Dhyan dene wale results dhoonde jaa rahe hain
report.preparing: Aapke liye simple summary likhi jaa rahi hai
report.normal_results_desc: Ye results aapki report mein di gayi range ke andar hain.
report.no_results: Is report se koi test result nahi padha jaa saka.
report.what_this_means: Iska kya matlab ho sakta hai
report.should_i_worry: Aap aage kya kar sakte hain
report.questions_heading: Aap apne doctor se yeh sawaal pooch sakte hain
report.questions_extra: Kya mere results mein aur bhi kuch hai jo mujhe jaanna chahiye?
report.cbc_explanation: CBC (Complete Blood Count) ek common blood test hai. Isme blood ke alag-alag parts check kiye jaate hain — jaise red blood cells, white blood cells, hemoglobin aur platelets. Doctor ise aapki general health check karne ke liye karte hain.
report.key_findings_heading: Doctor se charcha karne wali baatein
report.key_findings_desc: Yeh is report ke woh findings hain jo aapki agli appointment mein mention karne layak ho sakte hain.
report.no_key_findings: Is report ke saare results di gayi ranges ke andar hain.
report.pattern_cbc_intro: Inme se kuch results aapas mein jude hue hain aur inhe alag-alag ki jagah milkar dekhna zyada sahi ho sakta hai.
report.symptom_context_heading: Kya yeh aapke feel karne se match karta hai?
report.symptom_context_desc: Aap chahein to apne symptoms yahan note kar sakte hain. Isse aap doctor se better baat kar paenge.
report.symptom_placeholder: jaise thakaan, chakkar, saans lene mein takleef...
report.symptom_note: Yeh jaankari kahin nahi bheji jaati. Yeh sirf aapko appointment ki taiyaari mein help karne ke liye yahan dikhaayi jaati hai.
report.ask_ai_heading: Aapki report ke baare mein koi sawaal hai?
report.ask_ai_desc: Aap CareAI se apne results ke baare mein pooch sakte hain. Suggested sawaal:
report.ask_ai_prompt_1: Mere results simple bhasha mein samjhaayein
report.ask_ai_prompt_2: Doctor ko pehle kaunsa result bataaun?
report.ask_ai_prompt_3: Mujhe doctor se kya poochhna chahiye?
report.ask_ai_coming_soon: AI chat jald aa raha hai.
report.extraction_desc: Yeh dikhata hai ki aapki report se har value kitni reliability se padhi gayi.
report.extraction_uncertain: Review ki zaroorat ho sakti hai
report.confidence_low: Kripya original report se verify karein
report.ref_range_note: Reference ranges alag-alag labs mein alag ho sakti hain aur umar, ling, pregnancy, testing method jaise factors par depend karti hain. CareAI hamesha aapki report mein di gayi range use karta hai.
report.sources_desc: Is report mein use ki gayi general medical jaankari MedlinePlus, CDC, WHO aur standard laboratory guidelines par based hai.
report.disclaimer_text: Yeh report aapko apne laboratory results samajhne mein help karne ke liye banayi gayi hai. Yeh koi diagnosis nahi hai aur kisi qualified healthcare professional ki salah ki jagah nahi le sakti. Agar aapko concerning symptoms hain ya report mein koi critical result hai, to kripya appropriate medical care lein.
